title: Are There Jellyfish in Madeira, and Is It Safe to Swim From a Boat?
description: Yes, a few kinds drift past, and the Portuguese man o' war turns up in some springs. Most days a boat swim on the south coast is safe. What to check and do.
heroAlt: A Portuguese man o' war floating on the surface of the deep blue sea off Madeira
keywords: is it safe to swim in Madeira jellyfish
swimming from a boat in Madeira

Soft ripples, true colours, no boat, no people, realistic photo, no text.
